items.reason: The migration dereferences an empty category query result, aborting before the fallback can run.
It includes the same mixed-case hostname comparison bug as #03. The broader comment also describes the port mismatch in #14.
The normalization callback calls sub! on a nil host, raising instead of returning a validation error.
Update and destroy dereference a nil lookup result for an unknown host ID, returning a 500.
The lookup lowercases only the stored hostname, so mixed-case incoming hosts fail to match.
The blank-host test passes because other prerequisites are false and therefore does not test its named condition.
Missing category settings produce empty query results that the migration dereferences without checking.
The category and embeddable-host fabricator files contain each other's definitions.
The blank-host test name describes a removed condition, while the assertion passes because there is no topic embed.
The migration accesses the first category result without checking whether it exists, crashing before the fallback.
The before-validation callback invokes sub! on a nil host without a guard.
Both controller actions use a nullable host lookup without handling a missing record, causing a 500.
